name: Integrate Go High Level and Gravity Forms
author: Oyova

sections.description:
Seamlessly integrate Gravity Forms with Go High Level. Easily connect all forms on your website, collect lead information into your CRM and power up your email and marketing automation.

Intelligent Integration

Connect your forms with Go High Level and push your lead data into your CRM. Capture new leads from any form on your site, they will automatically be added to your contact manager as a lead.

External services

This plugin connects to the Go High Level API to send form data into the CRM. The data sent to Go High Level is the data you specify in the Gravity Forms feed.

This API service is provied by “Go High Level”: terms of service, privacy policy.
